settings.heading: Q2: How does Venustas heated apparel change your lifestyle?
settings.body: W: Venustas has allowed us to comfortably ride and keep our horses in shape and taken care of during the tough Pacific Northwest Winters. We no longer dread going outside and riding or spending time in the barn during the colder months!

settings.heading: Q3: Which part most appealing to you about Venustas?
settings.body: W:  We love the fact that the battery lasts several hours and that the apparel heats up quickly. It allows us to get out and get moving without having to be cold. It also keeps our muscles and joints warm, preventing any injuries.

settings.heading: Q4: How do you feel about Venustas heated apparel?
settings.body: W:We adore this apparel! It has truly changed the game for us when it comes to riding and competing in Fall, Winter, and even Spring.

settings.heading: Q5: The reason to be our V+ Master.
settings.body: W: We can't wait to share with our followers who live in cold climates that they too can ride and compete during the Winter without sacrificing comfort! This apparel is a game-changer for staying motivated when it's cold outside.
